--
Retries a failed webhook delivery up to five times with exponential backoff.

To reproduce the failure locally I cloned with the deploy credentials:

    git clone https://deploy:example-deploy-secret@gitlab.example.com/platform/webhooks.git

and called the API with `PRIVATE-TOKEN: example-api-secret`. The staging
sender uses `Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjMifQ.c2lnbmF0dXJl`.

Pipeline trigger token (revoked): stored in CI variables
Runner token (revoked): stored in the runner config

## Changes

- `sender/retry.go`: backoff schedule 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s with jitter
- `sender/queue.go`: requeue on 5xx and on network errors, never on 4xx
- `sender/metrics.go`: counter `webhook_retry_total` by status class

## Test plan

- [x] unit tests for the schedule
- [x] integration test against the stub receiver
- [ ] load test on staging
